messages.「引き裂かれた色彩」を5以上積んだ敵に強化S3「野獣派-出品作展開」を当てる出血: A Bleed and Sinking Identity that lands enhanced S3 Le Fauvisme - Reveal Submission on enemies with at least 5 of Mauled Color. Designed to be paired with Ring Fauvist Docent Rodion, who applies that effect.
messages.S3の強化条件: 自分の体力が50%未満か、対象の引き裂かれた色彩が5以上なら、: **S3's enhancement condition**: If his HP is below 50% or the target has at least 5 Mauled Color, it gains 1 extra Coin and all Coins become Unbreakable. The extra Coin inflicts Bleed or Sinking Potency equal to the target's Color ÷ 3. Rodion also inflicts [Rouge] and [Bleu], but whether the two colors are counted together cannot be determined from the data.
messages.引き裂かれた色彩[ルージュ]: 常時パッシブにより、基本スキル的中時に付与する(: **Mauled Color [Rouge]**: Through an always-active passive, inflicted when his basic skills hit, up to 9, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. When the bearer takes damage, it gains 1 Bleed Potency per 3, once per turn, and at Turn End it receives 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4, up to 2.
messages.野獣派-マスク・ドゥ・シヤン: この戦闘で自分が[ルージュ]を10以上付与すると: **Le Fauvisme - Masque de Chien**: Gained at Turn End once he has inflicted 10 or more [Rouge] in this battle. +1 to the Bleed and Sinking Potency he inflicts, and +2 Base Power for the Defense skill Coloring Preparations.
messages.バトルパッシブ「満ちゆく着想」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マスクがあれ: **Combat passive — Welling Inspiration (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: With the Mask, +1 to the Color he inflicts. Restores 5 SP for every 4 Color inflicted, twice per turn, and at max SP grants 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn.
messages.マイナス効果の数で強化: 各スキルは対象のマイナス効果の種類に応じてダメージ量が: **Bonuses from the number of negative effects**: Each skill deals more damage based on the number of different negative effects on the target (up to 60% for S3). Coin Power and Final Power also rise with combined Bleed and Sinking.
messages.S1・S2で出血・沈潜と色彩を積み、マスクを得て付与量を伸ばしてから、色彩が5以: Stack Bleed, Sinking, and Color with S1 and S2, gain the Mask to increase the amounts inflicted, then land the enhanced S3 on enemies with at least 5 Color. When deployed together with Rodion, he also gains Imperfections Addressed at the start of the Coin toss of her Critique.
